final: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as overall_average FROM account_orders), with_differences AS (SELECT ao.account_id, ao.region, ao.order_count, ao.order_count - oa.overall_average as difference_from_overall_avg FROM account_orders ao CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa), region_avg_differences AS (SELECT region, AVG(difference_from_overall_avg) as region_avg_difference FROM with_differences GROUP BY region) SELECT wd.account_id, wd.region, wd.order_count, wd.difference_from_overall_avg, wd.difference_from_overall_avg - rad.region_avg_difference as excess_over_region_avg FROM with_differences wd JOIN region_avg_differences rad ON wd.region = rad.region WHERE wd.difference_from_overall_avg > rad.region_avg_difference ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC LIMIT 10
